newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SKorea agrees $354.5 mln overseas bond issue plans.
newsitem.headline: SKorea agrees $354.5 mln overseas bond issue plans.

text.p: The Korea Securities Dealers Association said on Friday it had approved plans by local companies to issue $354.5 million of equity-linked bonds abroad during the second quarter.
The amount reflected a 44 percent drop from the previous quarter and a 34 percent fall from a year earlier, the association said in a statement.
The total breaks down into $259.5 million in convertible bonds, $25 million in bonds with warrants and $70 million on depositary receipts, it said.
Among major companies, Dong Ah Construction Industrial Co was allowed to issue $100 million in convertible bonds and Kwangju Bank $70 million in depositary receipts, it said.
